name: MonarchInlineNotice
title: InlineNotice
summary: A one-line message with a tone, attached to a field, a row, a card or a panel.
whenToUse: For a short note that belongs to one field or row: a validation warning, a conflict, a hint that something was saved.
whenNotToUse: For a block with a title on its own line, use MonarchBanner. For a failure with a retry, use MonarchInlineErrorRetry. For the error of a MonarchTextField, use its error parameter.
api: init(_ message: String, title: String? = nil, systemImage: String? = nil, tone: MonarchTone = .info, variant: MonarchInlineNoticeVariant = .subtle, toneLabel: String? = nil, actionTitle: String? = nil, dismissLabel: String? = nil, action: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onDismiss: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil)

options.name: title
options.description: A short bold lead-in on the same line, such as "Conflict."

options.name: systemImage
options.description: Replaces the SF Symbol of the tone.

options.name: tone
options.description: Selects the colours and the icon.

options.name: variant
options.description: subtle is a tinted strip; plain is an icon and coloured text only.

options.name: toneLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in spoken name of the tone.

options.name: actionTitle
options.description: Title of the action button. No button without it.

options.name: action
options.description: Runs when the action button is activated.

options.name: onDismiss
options.description: Runs when the dismiss button is activated. No dismiss button without it.

states.name: dismissible
states.description: A close button at the trailing edge, when onDismiss is given. The app removes the notice.

appearance: Caption text beside a small icon in the strong colour of the tone. The subtle variant sits on the subtle fill of the tone with 8-point corners and default text colour; the plain variant has no fill and its text takes the strong colour of the tone.
platformNotes: The notice does not hide itself: the app removes it in onDismiss, where the web can keep its own open state. The live option has no equivalent: post an announcement when you insert a notice. The action is a title and a closure, drawn as a small ghost button, instead of the web's action slot. Android builds the same component. Several closures are optional (action, onDismiss). Pass each one with its label: Swift gives a single unlabelled trailing closure to the first parameter that accepts it, which is action.
accessibility: The icon, title and message are one element, read as the tone name, the title, then the message.
The tone name is spoken, so the tone does not depend on colour; toneLabel replaces it. The neutral tone has no spoken name.
The action and the dismiss button are separate buttons with touch targets of at least 44 points.
The text wraps, and the action moves under it when both do not fit on one line.
The notice does not announce itself when it appears.
edgeCases: Despite the name, a long message wraps onto more lines; nothing is truncated.
With a dismiss button the notice is at least 44 points high.
actionTitle without action, or action without actionTitle, shows no button.

parityExceptions.reason: The dismiss button is shown when an onDismiss callback is passed, so the template passes one; there is no separate dismissible flag.
parityExceptions.convention: SwiftUI and Compose enable an optional control by passing its callback.

parityExceptions.reason: MonarchInlineNotice on iOS has no live-region option: a notice does not announce itself.
parityExceptions.convention: SwiftUI announces with AccessibilityNotification.Announcement, which the app posts when it inserts the notice.
